0.sound: Neutral. Folk sound-alikes include 灵 (líng, "spirited, efficacious") and 良 ("good"), but most people read 0 as "complete / nothing".

1.sound: Stands for "one", "first" and "whole". In phone numbers it is read yāo (幺), which can echo 要 ("want / will").

2.sound: Good things come in pairs (好事成双). In Cantonese 二 (ji6) sounds like 易 "easy".

3.sound: Cantonese: sounds like 生 (saang1) "life, birth, growth" — lucky. Mandarin: can echo 散 (sàn) "to scatter / break up" — mixed.

4.sound: Sounds like 死 (sǐ / sei2) "death" in both Mandarin and Cantonese.

5.sound: Mandarin: 五 links to the Five Elements (五行) and sounds like 我 (wǒ) "me" in internet slang (520 = "I love you"). Cantonese: ng5 sounds like 唔 "not".

6.sound: Sounds like 流 "flow" and 禄 "fortune / official salary". 六六大顺 = "everything goes smoothly".

7.sound: Can echo 起 "rise" and 齐 "together". Also associated with 气 "energy".

8.sound: Sounds like 发 (fā / faat3) "to prosper, make a fortune".
